_about: Walk-around mode: what villagers say in each kind of place, and one small quest. These are everyday first-century people, not Bible quotes. item is an emoji; count is how many to find.
hint: Walk to the star to see what happens!

villagers: Crowds come from Jerusalem and all Judea to hear John preach!
The river is cool today. Many are being baptized.
John wears camel's hair and eats locusts and wild honey.

quest.ask: My water jars rolled away down the bank. Can you find 3 of them?

villagers: It is hot and dry out here. Few people live in the wilderness.
Watch your step. There are rocks everywhere!

quest.ask: I dropped my flatbread along the path. Can you find 3 pieces?

villagers: Shalom! Welcome to our village.
Have you heard about the teacher from Nazareth?
My fig tree gave so much fruit this year!
The well is at the end of the street, if you are thirsty.

quest.ask: My hens got out of their pen! Can you find 3 eggs they laid?

villagers: This is Jacob's well. It is very deep.
People come here to draw water in the morning, when it is cool.

quest.ask: I need water for my animals. Can you find 3 empty jars?

villagers: Look at the lake! Galilee is beautiful in the spring.
The fishermen go out on the lake at night.
The flowers on these hills are lovely.

quest.ask: My sheep have wandered off. Can you find my 3 lambs?

villagers: We fish at night, when the fish come up near the surface.
Mending nets takes all morning!
Storms can come up suddenly on this lake.

quest.ask: Some fish fell out of my basket. Can you find 4 of them?

villagers: So many people came to hear Him teach!
Find a good place to sit on the grass.

quest.ask: My little brother lost his loaves. Can you find 3 of them?

villagers: The springs here flow down to the Jordan River.
This town is far to the north, near Mount Hermon.

quest.ask: I dropped my grapes on the rocks. Can you find 3 bunches?

villagers: Look at the Temple! Its white stones shine in the sun.
Many people travel to Jerusalem for the feasts.
The city is so crowded at Passover!

quest.ask: I am selling oil lamps, and some fell off my cart. Can you find 3?

villagers: These olive trees are very old.
From the Mount of Olives you can see all of Jerusalem.

quest.ask: The olives are ripe! Can you help me gather 4 of them?

villagers: The sun is just coming up over the garden.
Something wonderful has happened here!

quest.ask: Can you find 3 lilies for the garden?
